title: The agent hears what the person did in DCLab's card before it answers
request: The owner's own test in the app: after building from DCLab's card, 'ok show evaluation of the model' got 'There is no model to evaluate yet. The draft is still at its first question.'
plan: a note before the person's next message listing the card's moves since their last message
a test; a live check of the same question

decisions.decision: the note lists the moves and tells the agent to read the state, rather than the app reading DCLab's state itself
decisions.why: the agent's own tools give the whole state and its results; the note only has to stop it answering from memory

decisions.decision: the note rides on the existing appNote path (the rewind note's)
decisions.why: kept beside the message in the records, never shown or stored as the person's words

decisions.decision: read-only DCLab tools still ask in 'Ask first' mode
decisions.why: allowing them without a click changes what the person's mode means: the owner decides

findings.defect: the agent described a draft as it last saw it, after the person had built it in the card
findings.scenario: s_8f7c9cee8865: 7 card moves between turns, then 'ok show evaluation of the model': no tool call, 'the draft is still at its first question' while project 64aba1052de9 had run 9 stages
findings.cause: the card's moves happen outside the agent's view; nothing told it they had happened
findings.fix: a note before the next message with the moves and 'read it now: home_status, get_results'
findings.test: server test: the note first, then the words; no note when nothing happened; live: home_status called first

measurements.name: live
measurements.gate: the owner's question reads the state first
measurements.result: home_status called before the answer; the answer matched the draft; $0.17 + EUR 0.01

outcome: Whatever the person does in DCLab's card, the agent's next answer starts from DCLab's state, not its memory.
lessons: When the person can change state through a surface the agent does not see, tell the agent at the next message, and tell it to read before it speaks.
risks: a read-only status call still asks in 'Ask first' mode
